name: Marshal McBride
summary: Marshal Douglas McBride is the commander of the Stormwind garrison stationed at Northshire Abbey. Tasked with the defense of Northshire Valley, he directs freshly arrived recruits against the rising kobold infestation threatening local farms and mines. He serves as the primary military authority for newcomers beginning their service to the kingdom of Stormwind.

sections.title: Commander of Northshire
sections.body: Stationed right outside Northshire Abbey, Marshal Douglas McBride represents the direct authority of the Stormwind Army in this quiet valley. While the abbey itself is an enclave of faith and learning, rising turmoil across the kingdom has stretched military garrisons thin. McBride must maintain peace and secure the valley's food and resource supplies with only a handful of sworn guards and an influx of green recruits seeking training under the abbey's masters.

sections.title: The Kobold Incursion
sections.body: McBride's primary headache is the sudden aggression of local vermin. Kobolds, once merely a nuisance, have overrun the surrounding woods and seized Echo Ridge Mine—a vital local asset. Lacking the regular soldiers needed to clear them out, McBride marshals paladins, warriors, and other novices to push back the tunneling pests and uncover the extent of the infestation before the valley is completely choked off.

faq.answer: Marshal Douglas McBride is an officer of the Stormwind Army stationed as the garrison commander at Northshire Abbey. He is in charge of defending Northshire Valley and directing new recruits into service.

faq.q: Why is McBride having recruits fight kobolds?
faq.answer: Kobolds have infested the forests around Northshire and seized control of Echo Ridge Mine. With Stormwind's military stretched thin, McBride relies on newly arrived adventurers to clear the vermin and secure the area.

faq.q: Where does McBride send recruits next?
aliases: where do i go after mcbride
faq.answer: Once a recruit has demonstrated their capability by dealing with the threats in Northshire Valley, McBride directs them down the southern road to Goldshire to assist Marshal Dughan.

Echo Ridge Mine is a mineral-rich cavern located on the northern edge of Northshire Valley. It has recently been overrun by tunneling kobolds, prompting McBride to order several operations to reclaim it.

faq.q: Does McBride command the abbey itself?
aliases: who is in charge of the abbey
faq.answer: No. Northshire Abbey is maintained by the holy orders and priests of the Light. McBride oversees the military garrison tasked with defending the abbey and the surrounding valley.

faq.q: Is McBride concerned about threats beyond kobolds?
faq.answer: While kobolds are the most immediate nuisance, McBride watches for deeper instability. Bandits and outlaws hover at the fringes of the valley, signaling broader unrest brewing across Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: For humans beginning their adventures in Northshire, Marshal McBride is the first representative of Stormwind's royal authority they encounter.
McBride actively seeks out sturdy fighters to serve the kingdom, relying on frontline warriors to clear out the tunnels of Echo Ridge.
McBride represents the starting frontier of the Grand Alliance in the heartland of humanity, inducting recruits into service of the Crown.
